module_summary: vcdsupport.cpp is the POPSTARTER (PS1 .VCD) backend: it scans POPS/ folders into the game list, parses PS1 disc ids from filenames and HDD partition labels, keeps a session memo of disc-read ids resolved lazily on the IO worker, renames VCDs, resolves POPSTARTER.ELF and the argv selector, and manages everything POPSTARTER reads from the memory card (BDMAssault driver pair equip with a size table and marker file, POPSTARTER icons and modules, IPCONFIG/SMBCONFIG.DAT, UDPFS SYS-CONF DATs and PATHMAP.INI, Sony POPS file checks and copy offer, and the RA MODULE_9.IRX cleanup). All card writes go through a free-space-gated copy/write pair. vmcrebuild.cpp/.h rebuild a fragmented native VMC through genvmc and swap it in with two renames, keeping the old card as .bak; it is small, live (guigame.cpp) and clean.

reusable_helpers.name: vcdSafeCopyFile
reusable_helpers.what: copies a file in 16 KB heap chunks after a memory-card free-space check; unlinks a partial destination on error

reusable_helpers.name: vcdSafeWriteFile
reusable_helpers.what: writes a buffer to a file behind the same memory-card free-space gate; unlinks on a short write

reusable_helpers.name: vcdMcHasSpace
reusable_helpers.what: mcGetInfo-based free-space check for an mc0:/mc1: path with a 16 KB margin

reusable_helpers.name: vcdExtractGameId
reusable_helpers.what: parses a strict AAAA_NNN.NN PS1 game id (optionally after an XX./SB./EL./SM. prefix) and uppercases it

reusable_helpers.name: vcdIsHiddenDisc
reusable_helpers.what: detects disc 2+ tokens such as (Disc 2), [CD 3] in a filename

reusable_helpers.name: vcdJoinDirFile
reusable_helpers.what: joins a directory and file name using the directory's own separator ('/' or '\\')

reusable_helpers.name: vcdReadNetFile
reusable_helpers.what: reads a whole small text file into a buffer, distinguishing absent, IO error and too large

reusable_helpers.name: vcdUdpfsParseQuad
reusable_helpers.what: strict dotted-quad IPv4 parser that advances the text pointer

reusable_helpers.name: vcdSourceFileSize
reusable_helpers.what: file size via lseek, falling back to reading the file through when SEEK_END is unsupported (MMCE)

reusable_helpers.name: vcdStampPopstarterIcons
reusable_helpers.what: gives a memory-card folder an icon.sys/list.icn by copying or retitling the built-in save icon

reusable_helpers.name: vmcRebuildExists
reusable_helpers.what: proves a file's presence or absence by listing its folder with fileXioDread instead of trusting an open error

findings.title: VcdSupport class is a single-instance wrapper behind a parallel set of forwarding free functions
findings.problem: Every external caller uses the free functions (vcdInvalidateGameIds, vcdRequestDisplayId, ps1RowIdRequest, ps1RowIdCached, vcdEquipBdma, vcdEquipBdmaFromPops) that only forward to the one global gVcdSupport; the only outside use of the class is cuesupport.cpp:1090 noteScanDir. The class adds a 56-line header block, a static thunk for ioPutRequest and six one-line forwarders, and exposes private state (memo head, request slot, custom-path cache) in a public header.
findings.fix: Delete the class from vcdsupport.h. Move its fields into vcdsupport.cpp as file-static variables, make the methods file-static functions (resolveQueuedDisplayId can then be passed to ioPutRequest directly, no thunk), let the existing free functions carry the bodies, and add one free vcdNoteScanDir prototype for cuesupport.cpp. Update the source-text tests that name gVcdSupport/VcdSupport::equipBdma.
findings.benefit: ~45 net source lines removed (56-line header block and ~10 forwarder/thunk lines, minus ~8 lines of statics and one prototype); no ELF change expected beyond the 12-byte thunk (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep gVcdSupport|VcdSupport:: over the repo excluding vcdsupport.cpp: only include/vcdsupport.h:17,314,364, src/sources/cuesupport.cpp:1090 (noteScanDir) and .github/scripts tests (test_bdma_stale_pair.py:92, test_mc_folders.py:360, test_pops_udpfs.py:192,245, test_ps1_retrogem_metadata.py:70-159,353). All other methods are reached only from inside vcdsupport.cpp (evidence/RiptOPL/raw/all-xref-candidates.tsv marks equipBdma, resolveRowId, requestRowId, resolveQueuedDisplayId, rowIdCached, resolveCustomPopstarter as 'used only in its own file').

findings.title: vcdDisplayName(mode, text) is never called; only vcdDisplayNameForRow is used
findings.problem: The repo-wide matches for 'vcdDisplayName(' are its definition (vcdsupport.cpp:178) and prototype (vcdsupport.h:105); all display callers use vcdDisplayNameForRow. The section banner at vcdsupport.cpp:978-981 still calls it 'the only piece that stayed' and places it 'below', and three include comments name it as the reason for including vcdsupport.h.
findings.fix: Delete vcdDisplayName and its prototype/comment block, delete the stale banner at vcdsupport.cpp:978-981, and correct the three include comments (or drop the includes if nothing else from vcdsupport.h is used there).
findings.benefit: ~19 source lines removed; the 144-byte function is already dropped by --gc-sections, so no ELF change (MEASURED: evidence/RiptOPL/raw/riptopl-discarded-firstparty.txt lists .text._Z14vcdDisplayNameiPKc 144).
findings.evidence: Grep 'vcdDisplayName\(' over all of src/RiptOPL (C/C++, py, yaml, Makefile, docs): vcdsupport.cpp:178 and vcdsupport.h:105 only. Grep 'vcdDisplayName\b' shows the remaining hits are comments (coverflow.cpp:17, themeelems.cpp:19, themes.cpp:18, guisettings.cpp:1259, vcdsupport.cpp:204,218,980). Build evidence: riptopl-discarded-firstparty.txt and all-xref-candidates.tsv mark it 'unreferenced, removed by --gc-sections'.

findings.title: BDMA launch card checks open the POPSTARTER folder and marker repeatedly; vcdGetFileSize duplicates vcdSourceFileSize
findings.problem: vcdBdmaEnvironmentValid and vcdBdmaManualPairMatches are always evaluated together on the launch fast path (1837, 1848, 1899) and each repeats the same block: vcdFindPopstarterMc (opendir), build the two module paths, read both sizes, compare with vcdBdmaPairMatches. EnvironmentValid also calls vcdReadBdmaMode, which runs vcdFindPopstarterMc and opens the marker again, and ManualPairMatches opens the marker a third time. vcdGetFileSize is vcdSourceFileSize without the MMCE read-through fallback; on mc0:/mc1: they return the same value.
findings.fix: Fold the two checks into one function that finds the folder once, reads the two sizes once and the marker once, and returns ready when the sizes match and the marker is absent or names the mode (keeping the FAT32 'no pair' rule). Replace vcdGetFileSize with vcdSourceFileSize. Update test_bdma_shipped_pairs.py and test_mc_folders.py, which extract these functions by name.
findings.benefit: ~25 source lines removed; per VCD launch check ~2 fewer opendir and ~2 fewer marker opens on the memory card (INFERRED from the call chain 1837 -> 1775/1794->1386/1807/1811).
findings.evidence: Read vcdsupport.cpp:1383-1408, 1712-1838, 1844-1849, 1896-1903. Grep vcdGetFileSize: only 1720 (definition), 1782-1783, 1821-1822. Grep vcdBdmaEnvironmentValid|vcdBdmaManualPairMatches: callers only at 1837, 1848, 1876, 1899, 1903 plus the source-text tests .github/scripts/test_bdma_shipped_pairs.py:29-66 and test_mc_folders.py:68-70,190,356.

findings.title: vcdEnsureBdmaForLaunch and vcdApplyUsbModeForLaunch repeat the failure-toast ladder and re-inline vcdBdmaLaunchReady
findings.problem: The -4/-5/-2/else warning ladder (8 lines) is copied verbatim in both launch helpers. Both fast-path conditions are vcdBdmaLaunchReady(mode) written out again: at 1899 the extra 'mode == VCD_BDMA_USBEXFAT &&' guard is redundant because vcdBdmaManualPairMatches already returns 0 for FAT32.
findings.fix: Call vcdBdmaLaunchReady(mode) at 1848 and 1899, and move the ladder into one small static function called from both places.
findings.justification: The helper replaces two identical 8-line copies with one, a net removal of about 6 lines; no behaviour change.
findings.benefit: ~8 source lines removed (INFERRED: 2x8 ladder lines -> 1x9 helper + 2 calls; 2 shorter conditions).
findings.evidence: Read 1835-1915 side by side; the two ladders differ only in the preceding LOG text. vcdBdmaManualPairMatches returns 0 when mode <= VCD_BDMA_FAT32 (1803-1804), so 1899 equals vcdBdmaEnvironmentValid(mode) || vcdBdmaManualPairMatches(mode) == vcdBdmaLaunchReady(mode). udpfssupport.cpp:806-809 uses msgBox with a ternary instead, so it is not a third copy of this ladder.

findings.title: mc0/mc1 POPSTARTER folder tables and the mkdir-then-verify step are written out several times
findings.problem: The same {"mc0:/POPSTARTER","mc1:/POPSTARTER"} table is declared in vcdFindPopstarterMc and again in vcdResolvePopstarterMc, and vcdPopstarterNetDirs is a 10-line function that snprintf's the same two strings into a caller buffer of 2x96 bytes with a maxDirs argument that is always 2. vcdEnsurePopstarterNetDir and vcdResolvePopstarterMc:1358-1364 both do mkdir then opendir to confirm; the mc0:/ mc1:/ root list appears at 1345 and inline at 2156.
findings.fix: Keep one file-scope static const table of the two POPSTARTER folders (and one of the two card roots), iterate it directly in vcdResolvePopstarterNetHome, delete vcdPopstarterNetDirs, and have vcdResolvePopstarterMc call vcdEnsurePopstarterNetDir instead of its own mkdir/opendir pair.
findings.benefit: ~14 source lines and a 192-byte stack buffer per network-config read removed (INFERRED: char dirs[2][96] at 2685).
findings.evidence: Grep vcdPopstarterNetDirs: definition 2025 and single call 2687 with maxDirs=2. Grep vcdEnsurePopstarterNetDir: 2819 definition, calls 2867, 2960, 3010. Read vcdFindPopstarterMc 1319-1336 and vcdResolvePopstarterMc 1342-1369.

findings.title: Small hand-copied loops in vcdsupport.cpp: id character-class checks, last-separator search, write-all loop
findings.problem: The '4 alphanumerics' id check is written four times (vcdExtractGameId, both forms of vcdCanonDisplayId, vcdPopsPartitionTitleOffset form B) and the 'AAAA-NNNNN' digit run twice; 'last of / or \\' is computed three times (vcdDirSep, the custom-ELF folder in equipBdma, the source folder before icon stamping); vcdSafeCopyFile and vcdSafeWriteFile each carry the same write-until-done loop.
findings.fix: Add one static id-prefix check (4 alnum) and one dash-form check used by the three parsers, one static last-separator function that vcdDirSep and both equipBdma sites use, and let vcdSafeCopyFile call a shared write-all loop that vcdSafeWriteFile also uses.
findings.justification: Each helper replaces 2-4 identical copies inside this one file and removes more lines than it adds (about 14 net); behaviour is unchanged.
findings.benefit: ~14 net source lines removed (INFERRED from the cited ranges); negligible ELF change.
findings.evidence: Read every cited range; the loops are character-for-character equivalent apart from the variable name (p, tail, tmp). The separator logic at 1495-1500 and 1606-1610 is identical; vcdDirSep 784-786 is the same test returning a char.

findings.title: Stale comments, an unreachable clamp and an unused include in vcdsupport.cpp/.h
findings.problem: textures.h is included for texDiscoverLoad/ERR_BAD_FILE, neither of which the file uses; other include comments name guiWarning and bdmGetDeviceRootByType (not used) and a function that 'never existed'. 228-229 is an orphaned header for vcdScanOpenDir; 621-622 documents a function that is not there; 692-693 is a clamp its own comment calls unreachable (ISO_GAME_NAME_MAX 160 < VCD_NAME_MAX-1); 1031-1032 says the art miss-memo invalidation lives in vcdScanOpenDir, but no such code exists anywhere; 2069-2070 describes a parser above vcdUdpfsAddress. The header says BDMA equip lives in system.c/opl.c and that vcdFillGameList frees *outGames first; both are wrong.
findings.fix: Delete the orphaned/false comments and the unreachable clamp, drop the textures.h include (confirm by compiling), and correct the include comments and the two header comments.
findings.benefit: ~12 source lines removed; no ELF change (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep in vcdsupport.cpp for tex[A-Z]|ERR_BAD_FILE|guiWarning|bdmGetDeviceRootByType: only the include comments match. supportbase.h:7 ISO_GAME_NAME_MAX 160; vcdsupport.h:19 VCD_NAME_MAX 256. Grep (?i)art.?miss|miss.?memo over src/: only the 1031 comment. Read vcdScanOpenDir 626-742 (no invalidation call) and vcdFillGameList 1021-1070 (frees *outGames only after the scan succeeds).

findings.title: vcdReadBdmaMode still accepts an interim 'udpfsnet' marker that this repo never writes
findings.problem: The marker writer only emits vcdBdmaSuffix tokens ('udpfs' for UDPFS); 'udpfsnet' is read-side compatibility for an interim PR marker. git log -S'udpfsnet' shows only the commit that added this read. A card carrying it would still need the exact current pair sizes to be accepted, so dropping the alias only turns that case into one re-equip.
findings.fix: Delete the two-line alias and the source-text assertion that pins it.
findings.benefit: 2 source lines and one test line removed (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep -i udpfsnet over the repo: vcdsupport.cpp:1401 and test_pops_udpfs.py:197 only. vcdWriteBdmaMarker (1373-1381) writes vcdBdmaSuffix[mode] (1222). git -C src/RiptOPL log -S'udpfsnet': one commit, d04f402e81. That no released build wrote 'udpfsnet' to a card is INFERRED (it may come from the original project's interim PR).
